## Où j'en suis
Terraform for the Postgres 17 upgrade on the analytics RDS is prepared on branch noa/rds-pg17: parameter group family derived from major version, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod staged behind `pg17_enabled = false`. Plans are clean (staging: 1 add, 1 change; prod: no changes), nothing applied, and draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open with the caveats in the description.

- [en-cours] Staging upgrade ready to apply, but blocked on pg_partman: 4.7.4 must be upgraded to 5.x on 16.4 first (ALTER EXTENSION, then check `run_maintenance_proc()` on events_raw/events_daily)
- [prochaine-étape] Run the pg_partman 5.x upgrade on staging, then apply the blue/green update
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a production window after Maya's sign-off, avoiding the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC); lowest-traffic slots outside the lock are Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` failed with the old lock file (aws 5.31.0 vs constraint >= 5.60.0); upgrading to provider v6 introduced unrelated breaking changes, so AWS was pinned to ~> 5.82.0 instead
- [décision] Plan only, never apply in this session (source: t01)
- [décision] Pin AWS provider to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade is a separate todo; do not run anything against the DB (source: t10)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false (source: t14)
